c: Resolve when the caller can work again, by a fix or an agreed workaround.
say: Resolve when the caller can work again, with a fix or an agreed workaround.
Press resolve in the incident's header.

c: Choose the Resolution code and write the Resolution notes. Duplicate asks for the parent; Known error needs the article attached.
say: Choose the resolution code and write the notes in words the caller understands. Duplicate asks for the parent incident. Known error needs the article attached first.

c: The incident is Resolved and the caller is emailed. Child incidents are resolved with it.
say: The incident is resolved and the caller is emailed. Child incidents are resolved with it.

c: The caller confirms or reopens; untouched, it closes after 7 days.
say: The caller confirms or reopens. If nobody touches it, it closes after seven days.
